critical_failures: Consignee mismatch: certificate consignee cannot be identified in any invoice recipient field.
overall_assessment.decision_summary: Document roles were identified with high confidence. Consignor, goods description, quantity and origin were verified against the invoice, but consignee failed because the certificate names Asia Coconut Processing Joint Stock Company while the invoice names Tetra Pak Vietnam Joint Stock Co. As at least one applicable control point is MISMATCH, the overall result is NOT_IDENTICAL.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Avsändare, varor, mängd och ursprungsland kan verifieras mot fakturan. Certifikatet anger mottagaren som Asia Coconut Processing Joint Stock Company, men fakturan anger mottagaren/köparen som Tetra Pak Vietnam Joint Stock Co. Därför är dokumenten inte identiska och kräver manuell handläggning.
